{{Quote|Welcome to Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium. Where all your starships dreams can come true.|[[Abagga Creel]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" />}}
'''Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium''' was a [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] business which dealt in the manufacturing and selling of [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==History==
{{Quote|You could help me track down my missing shipment. If you're able to find it, then not only will I be able to fulfill the order these two gentlemen placed, but I'll also be able to complete construction on my own starships.|[[Ral Mundi]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" />}}
Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium was headquartered in a [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscraper]] in the bustling [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The Emporium was headed by [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Merchant/Legends|businessman]] [[Ral Mundi]], and staffed by a number of employees, including [[Abagga Creel]]<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> and [[Tomi Jinsin]].<ref name="SWG:RtMSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Reacquire the Missing Starship Component Shipment|Corellia}}</ref>

[[File:TsomcrenMundiJaxx.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Ral Mundi]] alongside [[Tarth Jaxx]] and [[Io Tsomcren]] waiting for the missing shipment.]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an important shipment of starship components ordered by Ral Mundi disappeared during its transports, putting the company in trouble. Mundi put all of his available funds into this shipment and two shipwrights, [[Tarth Jaxx]] and [[Io Tsomcren]], were waiting for the shipment with impatience. Ral Mundi was afraid to not be able to pay back the shipwrights for the missing shipment, nor even be able to complete other projects. Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium was on the verge of ruin so Mundi requested the help of the [[Corellian Security Force]]. CorSec [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] sent a spacer who worked with Ral Mundi and his assistant Abagga Creel to find information concerning the missing shipment.<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> The spacer later discovered that the shipment was stolen by the [[Ragtags]], with the help of Tomi Jinsin who was himself a Ragtag thug. The spacer retrieved the shipment in the [[Coronet Capitol]], along with a crate of illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. The retrieval of the missing shipment saved the company from bankrupt and Mundi was indeed very grateful.<ref name="SWG:RtMSC" /> Further investigation of the CorSec about the shipment robbery and the smuggled spice would led to the discovery of a plot of the [[Rogue CorSec]] to overthrow the [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]] himself.<ref name="SWG:RtToaGD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Receive the Thanks of a Grateful Diktat|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ral Mundi's Starship Emporium was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 21 Notes for 4 August 2005|Publish 21]]," on [[August 4]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> Ral Mundi's quest was revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 27 is now live!">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=66900&month=022006|text=Publish 27 is now live!}}</ref> as the quest was inserted into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:FtMSOSC" /><ref name="SWG:RtMSC" />
